answer.justification: Only activation measurements are available. Layer-1 relative L2 is 0.036, below every category's range (quantized 0.096-0.105, fine-tuned 0.086-0.092, system-prompted 0.113-0.133), and onset is very early (layer 2). The layer-2 spike is 0.1, which rules out system-prompted (31.7-64.0). Quantized is unlikely because its difference is flat after layer 8 (about 0.2 by layer 24), whereas here it keeps growing to 0.554 at layer 32. The effective rank of 3.82 is within the fine-tuned range (2.89-3.58) only loosely, and direction consistency of 0.608 is just under the fine-tuned range (0.618-0.705). The early onset and a steady rise in difference with depth fit a low-rank fine-tune best. The mid-layer size ratio of 0.980 is closer to system-prompted or quantized than to fine-tuned (1.017-1.023). Several values fall outside every range, so confidence is moderate.
